description.value: Pappa Leo's Pizza is a locally owned and operated chain founded in 2003 by two brothers in Pitt Meadows, now expanded to 7 Metro Vancouver locations. The Port Coquitlam shop makes pizza dough fresh daily and sources quality ingredients, earning multiple best-pizza awards. Gluten-free crust is available, and the location offers both pickup and delivery.

address.value: 3237 Coast Meridian Rd, Port Coquitlam, BC V3B 3N3
